EUR.explainer: These returns are time-weighted: each day's growth is chained, so deposits do not distort them, and they can differ from the Overview's lifetime return, which is money-weighted. The money figure is summed day by day: each day, the dollars you held then were revalued from the previous day's rate to that day's. The Overview card instead compares today's dollars with what they cost at your average buy rate, so the two differ whenever the rate moved while your holdings grew or shrank.

jobs.description: Fetch the latest prices for every holding.
jobs.label: Refresh prices now

jobs.description: Drops the cached closes and splits of one instrument (manual fixes stay) and downloads them again, then rebuilds the valuation history.
jobs.label: Re-download one instrument's prices

jobs.description: Download stock splits for every instrument again.
jobs.label: Re-fetch splits

jobs.description: Fetch the current EUR/USD market rate (or backfill the last forex session's closing rate when the currency market is closed) from Yahoo Finance / Tiingo so today's figures do not rely on the ECB end-of-day reference rate.
jobs.label: Refresh live FX rate now

jobs.description: Fill gaps in the daily EUR rates from the ECB reference rates.
jobs.label: Re-download FX history

jobs.description: Recompute the stored EUR/USD legs of transactions from the FX history.
jobs.label: Recalculate FX legs

params.label: Recompute every row, not only missing ones
params.name: force

jobs.description: Recompute the daily portfolio values (from a date, or all).
jobs.label: Rebuild valuation history

jobs.description: Rebuild the intraday graphs: re-download the minute prices and the EUR/USD minute rates for the last session and week (Yahoo Finance, Tiingo filling gaps), so the EUR line uses the rate of each minute. Use it when the EUR 1D / 1W line has holes or sits on a flat daily rate.
jobs.label: Reload 1D / 1W graphs (prices + EUR/USD)

jobs.description: Download missing 1 Week intraday price bars for held stocks and ETFs into the per-holding price cache without altering the stored portfolio 1D / 1W curve.
jobs.label: Backfill 1W per-holding intraday bars

jobs.description: Delete the stored 1D or 1W samples; they refill during the next session.
jobs.label: Clear intraday samples

jobs.description: Remove cached prices of instruments no longer in the ledger.
jobs.label: Clean up cache

jobs.description: Deletes all prices, FX rates, snapshots and graph samples, then downloads them again. Transactions and settings stay. A backup is taken first.
jobs.label: Reset cached market data

jobs.description: Download the benchmark's price history again.
jobs.label: Refresh benchmark

jobs.description: Fetch the current risk-free rate.
jobs.label: Refresh risk-free rate

jobs.description: Fill holes in the 1 Day / 1 Week graphs where yfinance has no bars, from Tiingo's 5-minute prices. Costs one Tiingo request per held stock/ETF plus one for EUR/USD; refuses if the hourly/daily allowance can't cover it. Your own live points are never replaced.
jobs.label: Fill graph gaps from Tiingo

jobs.description: Ask Tiingo for every holding whose price is behind (skips the ones already current, so it only spends requests where Tiingo can add something).
jobs.label: Re-pull prices from Tiingo

jobs.description: Forget the Tiingo request counters and learned NAV timings (caps stay).
jobs.label: Reset Tiingo budget state

jobs.description: Fetch the twins' prices for the current/last session (previous close and the price now while the market is open), backfill any missing earlier-week bars, and top up the one-year close history the twin-accuracy figures read.
jobs.label: Refresh ETF twin prices now

jobs.description: Force the one-year daily-close backfill to run again for every twin currently held, even one already done or given up on after repeated failures — use this after fixing a twin mapping, or to fill a gap downtime left in the history.
jobs.label: Re-download ETF twin history

jobs.description: Delete every stored ETF-twin price (intraday bars and session closes) and reset its backfill markers; the next refresh fills them in again. Use this to reset a bad twin mapping.
jobs.label: Clear stored twin prices

jobs.description: Write a sealed snapshot of the database.
jobs.label: Back up now

jobs.description: Unseal a snapshot in a temporary folder and run an integrity check.
jobs.label: Verify a backup

jobs.description: SQLite integrity check of the live database.
jobs.label: Run integrity check

uses.detail: When yfinance fails, returns nothing, or serves frozen quotes for a stock or ETF during the session, the latest IEX price is fetched from Tiingo (automatic, after a short grace period).
uses.title: Live price backup

uses.detail: After the close, when yfinance has not yet published a mutual fund's NAV, a few spaced-out probes ask Tiingo whether it has it (automatic, at most 8 a day).
uses.title: Fund NAV check

uses.detail: When yfinance has no intraday EUR/USD bars for the 1 Day / 1 Week graph, one request fetches them from Tiingo (automatic).
uses.title: EUR/USD intraday bars

uses.detail: Fills holes in the 1 Day / 1 Week graphs where yfinance has no bars: one request per held stock/ETF plus one for EUR/USD. Runs by itself when a frozen-feed stall ends, or from Repair > Providers > Fill graph gaps from Tiingo.
uses.title: Graph gap fill

uses.detail: Repair > Providers > Re-pull prices from Tiingo: checks every holding against Tiingo once, skipping those that already have the newest price.
uses.title: Manual price re-pull

fields.help: What the number and time formats below follow while they are on 'auto'. en-US: 1,234.56, 12h · de-DE: 1.234,56, 24h. Dates have their own setting. Also picks the currency symbol placement.
fields.label: Regional preset

fields.help: How dates are written, independent of the regional preset. Each option shows today's date.
fields.label: Date format

fields.help: Separators for numbers and amounts: 1,234.56 · 1.234,56 · 1 234,56 · 1'234.56. 'auto' follows the regional preset.
fields.label: Number and currency format

fields.help: 'Browser' follows the device you are using; 'Local' is the server's zone.
fields.label: Timezone

fields.help: 24h: 14:05 · 12h: 2:05 PM. 'auto' follows the regional preset (en-US 12h, others 24h).
fields.label: Time format

fields.help: How holding charts scale when average cost (Price mode) or money invested (Value mode) sits far outside the plotted range. 'Auto' keeps the y-axis zoomed to the curve if cost/invested would flatten it (showing an edge cue or legend toggle instead); 'Always' always includes it on the axis; 'Data only' scales strictly to the curve.
fields.label: Holding chart cost / invested scale

fields.help: Adds a 'top winner' / 'top loser' pill beside the symbol of the biggest movers in the Overview's Holdings list. Off by default: the pill often pushes the symbol line onto a second row, and the Top movers card above already names them.
fields.label: Mark the day's top movers in the Holdings list

fields.help: How long the Daily Brief above the Overview stays open before it closes itself and counts as seen. 0 keeps it open until you close it.
fields.label: Daily Brief closes after (minutes, 0 = never)

fields.help: The Daily Brief covers what happened while you were away. Leaving the app (or its tab) for at least this long, then coming back, counts as a new visit; shorter breaks, like flicking to another tab, do not.
fields.label: New visit after being away (minutes)

fields.help: How often prices refresh while the US stock market is open.
fields.label: Price refresh while the stock market is open

fields.help: Bar width a graph reload (repull) asks Yahoo for. 'auto' matches the price refresh above (1 minute at 60 s). Yahoo serves 1-minute bars for about the last 7 days and 2-minute bars for about 60 days, so older days fall back to the finest available. A reload only fills gaps; it never replaces finer points already stored.
fields.label: Graph reload resolution

fields.help: Ticker the portfolio is compared against ('Vs market').
fields.label: Benchmark symbol

fields.help: A fraction (0.04 = 4 %). Leave empty to use the fetched rate.
fields.label: Manual risk-free rate

fields.help: Yearly real-return assumptions as fractions (0.07 = 7 %).
fields.label: Projection scenarios

fields.help: Used when the portfolio has too little history for its own rate.
fields.label: Fallback expected rate

fields.help: Symbols treated as cash-like settlement funds, on top of the built-in list.
fields.label: Extra money-market funds
Rows shown in an import preview

fields.help: An imported row that is almost identical to a transaction you already have (same account, instrument and type, a nearby date, almost the same amount and shares) is shown as an update instead of a new row; confirming overwrites the existing transaction with the import's figures. Exact duplicates are always skipped. Switch off to import such rows as new.
fields.label: Match near-identical rows as updates

fields.help: Amount and shares may differ by this fraction (0.005 = 0.5 %) and still count as the same transaction. The larger of this and the absolute tolerances applies.
fields.label: Update match: relative tolerance

fields.help: Amounts may differ by this much in the account's currency (a few cents).
fields.label: Update match: amount tolerance

fields.help: Share quantities may differ by this many shares.
fields.label: Update match: shares tolerance

fields.help: Dates may differ by this many NYSE trading days (weekends and holidays do not count).
fields.label: Update match: date distance

fields.help: Estimated transactions (from your recurring plans) are matched more loosely: the amount may differ by this fraction. Shares are ignored for buys and sells.
fields.label: Estimate match: relative tolerance

fields.help: Estimated transactions: the amount may differ by this much in the account's currency.
fields.label: Estimate match: amount tolerance

fields.help: Estimated transactions: the broker may book them this many trading days off.
fields.label: Estimate match: date distance

fields.help: A Wise statement can hold conversions into other currencies (for example EUR to GBP). 7.3 only supports EUR to USD, so with this on those rows are left out of the preview without a fuss; with it off they are listed but cannot be imported.
fields.label: Import: ignore conversions not into USD

fields.help: Column layouts remembered by the flexible importer: header signature -> JSON layout. Written from the Import page; delete an entry to forget a layout.
fields.label: Saved column layouts

fields.help: Broker action text -> transaction kind (or 'ignore'), for actions the importer does not know. Matched case-insensitively; wins over the built-in rules.
fields.label: Fidelity action mapping

fields.help: Broker action text -> transaction kind (or 'ignore'), for actions the importer does not know. Matched case-insensitively; wins over the built-in rules.
fields.label: Vanguard action mapping

fields.help: Broker action text -> transaction kind (or 'ignore'), for actions the importer does not know. Matched case-insensitively; wins over the built-in rules.
fields.label: Generic action mapping

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: ETF price age

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: Stock price age

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: Mutual-fund NAV re-check (until the NAV is in)

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: Cash price age

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: Savings price age

fields.help: How long the server waits before asking the provider again for this kind of holding (only while a newer price can exist: during the session, or after the close until the day's close / NAV is in).
fields.label: Other asset classes

fields.help: The figures are called Live only while the market is open, the last price pull is at most this old and the newest stock/ETF price itself was struck on the exchange at most this long ago. Keep it above the ETF/stock price age, or Live flickers between pulls.
fields.label: Live: newest price at most this old

fields.help: When every stock/ETF price stays exactly unchanged (or the provider's own price time is older) for this long while the market is open, the feed counts as stalled: the top bar says Delayed, no 1 Day graph points are stored, and Health & Repair lists the stretch.
fields.label: Frozen price feed: alarm after

fields.help: Your rate (pool): a buy costs the euros that really bought its dollars, oldest dollars first, from your conversions. ECB on the buy date: the official rate of the day you bought (the figures before 7.4). Only the EUR cost, gain and return per holding change; dollar figures never do.
fields.label: EUR cost of a holding

fields.help: While currencies trade (Sunday evening to Friday evening, New York time), Health & Repair warns when the live EUR/USD rate is missing, has not been refreshed for this long, or has stayed exactly the same for this long (a frozen feed). The ECB rate is each day's official rate and never warns on its own.
fields.label: Live EUR/USD rate: warn when stale after

fields.help: The Currency page's 1D and 1W rate chart uses 15-minute EUR/USD bars from Yahoo (around the clock on weekdays). The server keeps the bars it fetched for this long before asking Yahoo again, so opening the page does not call Yahoo every time. A failed fetch is also kept this long before a retry. Shorter means a fresher chart and more Yahoo calls.
fields.label: Currency chart 1D/1W: reuse rate bars for

fields.help: While a mutual fund's NAV for the session has not posted yet, its ETF twin estimates it, and that estimate replaces the headline portfolio value (and the Holdings rows' twin figures) everywhere on the Overview and Holdings pages. Turn this off to show only the official total, with its last posted NAV, until the real NAV lands — the twin-accuracy figures below still track how the twin has been doing, they are just not blended into the total.
fields.label: Estimate pending mutual-fund NAVs from their ETF twin

fields.help: A mutual fund's estimate (while its NAV is not posted yet) comes from its ETF twin. The Holdings page shows how far the twin was from the real NAV: the last session, and the typical gap and bias over this many recent sessions. Sessions with a dividend or distribution are left out.
fields.label: ETF twin accuracy: look back over

fields.help: EUR/USD trades around the clock on weekdays (Sunday 17:00 to Friday 17:00 New York time) on its own clock, separate from the stock market: it is checked at this pace whenever it trades, day or night.
fields.label: Currency refresh while the currency market is open

fields.help: A pause always ends by itself after this long.
fields.label: Pausing the scheduler lasts

fields.help: Currencies whose EUR rate history is kept (ISO codes).
fields.label: Tracked FX currencies

fields.danger: Changing it needs a fresh login.
fields.help: Fallback price source. Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
fields.label: Tiingo API token

fields.help: The app's own limit on Tiingo requests per hour, below Tiingo's free-plan allowance so the key is never used up. Every Tiingo use (price backup, NAV checks, EUR/USD bars, graph gap fill, probes) counts. Health & Repair shows how many are used and left.
fields.label: Tiingo requests per hour

fields.help: The app's own limit on Tiingo requests per day (New York time), below Tiingo's free-plan allowance so the key is never used up. Every Tiingo use (price backup, NAV checks, EUR/USD bars, graph gap fill, probes) counts. Health & Repair shows how many are used and left.
fields.label: Tiingo requests per day
Back up this long after a change

fields.help: DEBUG logs every data pull; switch back when done.
fields.label: Log detail

fields.help: Can only be lower than the server's configured value.
fields.label: Sign out after idle (minutes)

fields.help: Can only be lower than the server's configured value.
fields.label: Sign out at the latest after (days)

fields.help: Passkey changes and backup downloads need a recent sign-in.
fields.label: Re-sign-in for sensitive actions after (minutes)

fields.help: Per client address. Can only be lower than the server's value.
fields.label: Failed sign-ins allowed per minute
